name: player_update_alt_gun_aim_basis_origin
description: Player::UpdateAltGunAimBasisOrigin computes the alt-gun aim basis origin from the gun-node, turret-node, and cached gun-fire transform matrices.
known_limits: Binary Ninja assembly inspection in the current session verified the fastcall save-state/out-vector ABI, gun-node and turret-node Object3D matrix reads, local aim point derived from gun.posZ with turret.zx/zz and gun.posY plus turret.posY, and transform through playerState->gunFireTransform into the output vector.
The native smoke checks a nontrivial gun/turret/gunFireTransform matrix case before exercising adjacent aim-basis composition and fire-point selection behavior.

Binary Ninja still carries a limited reconstruction marker because the original uses unrolled x87 float arithmetic; no VC manifest covers 0x43b3e0 yet, so tier S verification is deferred to a player aim/source-cluster pass.
